statement: In pinned Linux v7.3 hid-steam the physical 28de:1302 HID starts with HIDINPUT but without HIDRAW while a layered client starts with HIDRAW only. Opening the raw client removes kernel-created gamepad/sensor evdev asynchronously but does not disconnect physical HIDINPUT. The IBEX raw callback returns zero and HID core processes report fields and HIDINPUT events; therefore physical report 0x40 mouse and 0x41 keyboard can still reach the host if firmware emits them while a raw client is open. No direct wired measurement of their emission under competing clients is claimed.

applicability.revision: Host kernel v7.3-rc1 (cee9395), direct wired USB 28de:1302 HID input mapping; Puck receiver only for separate comparison; Steam Stable 1792618285 remains unobserved this lane
applicability.firmware: Wired retail firmware unchanged/unmeasured by follow-up; physically observed D9 attributes remain under #101 only
applicability.scope: Host consumer code conclusion (O2/O5); conditioned on nonempty mouse/keyboard report fields and firmware emission; kernel paths do not prove retail response to setting9/71.
